tr.td: Structure or result object returned by ODE, DDE, or BVP solvers.

Dense output, plotting, post-processing, and solution comparison.

description.p: The result has one row per state variable and one column per evaluation point. This shape is used for both row and column vectors of evaluation times. Evaluation points must lie inside the solution interval. The optional second output returns the derivative at the same points.
